codeReview.summary: The production harness wiring in `packages/agent/src/test-harness.ts` is correctly ordered for this feature: `clearStorage()` drains after `stopSync()` and before `agentDid`/store mutation, and `closeStorage()` drains before store closes. However, the newly added VAL-HARNESS-005 subprocess test hardcodes the mission-local absolute repository path, which makes the test non-portable and likely to fail in CI or any checkout not located at `/tmp/fix-eager-send`.

issues.description: VAL-HARNESS-005 uses `Bun.spawn(..., { cwd: '/tmp/fix-eager-send/packages/agent' })`. This absolute path is environment-specific; outside this mission workspace (e.g., CI runners, developer clones in different directories) the subprocess cwd will not exist, causing spurious test failures and breaking portability.

VAL-HARNESS-002 probes `syncStore` open/closed state. Because `syncStore.close()` occurs near the end of `closeStorage()` (`packages/agent/src/test-harness.ts:179`), this test does not strictly guard the stronger contract "drain before any store close" for earlier closes like `dwnDataStore.close()`/`dwnMessageStore.close()`.
